card.name: Slot before a famous-person description
card.fires_on: Marks the spot right after a named person, place or thing where a descriptive tag like 'famous for' or 'hailed by' could come next. It often fires on a comma or 'the' after a famous name such as Frank Lloyd Wright or Olmsted.

modes.label: Comma after famous name
modes.description: A comma right after a well-known person's name, before a descriptor clause.
modes.example: is the work of Frank Lloyd Wright<<,>> hailed by the American institute of Architects as

modes.label: Linking word before a known entity
modes.description: A small word like 'the' or 'in' just before a well-known title or entity.
modes.example: The campus features several buildings by<< the>> man known for the Guggenheim Museum

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: A word inside a place or institution name that is not yet complete.
modes.example: the University of Arkansas and the University of<< South>> begin their project

card.writes: It suppresses words like famously, famous and iconic, so it stops a fame descriptor from being the next word.
card.plain: It fires where a famous name has just appeared and the text could go on to call it famous, and it steers away from that.
